verdict.rationale: Mercury exposes a dedicated Accounting/Accounts Receivable-adjacent API surface covering transactions, categories, statements, merchants, invoices, customers, webhooks, and events, plus QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite sync, sandbox testing, OAuth2, and an official Go SDK, letting developers view and manage accounting-related data programmatically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the accounting-specific endpoints (categories, statements, AR API) beyond vendor docs, and no official npm/PyPI SDK for broader language coverage.
